# uzc_regions (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud regions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_regions" "all" {}

data "uzc_regions" "vm_capable" {
  service = "Virtual Machine"
}

output "region_slugs" {
  value = [for r in data.uzc_regions.vm_capable.regions : r.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `service` (String) Filter to regions that support this service (e.g. "Virtual Machine").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `regions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider_id` (String)
- `continent_code` (String)
- `continent_name` (String)
- `country` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `id` (String) UzCloud's internal UUID for this region.
- `is_coming_soon` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `status` (Boolean)
